:::{#exm-prevalence}
#### Prevalence of COVID-19

Suppose 7% of the population being tested with the COVID-19 test of @exm-sensitivity
has COVID-19.
Then the prevalence (@def-prevalence) is:

$$\Pr(D) = 0.07$$

and, by the
[complement rule](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#cor-p-neg0),
the probability that a person drawn from that population does not have COVID-19 is:

$$
\ba
\Pr(\neg D)
&= 1 - \Pr(D)
&& \text{(complement rule)} \\
&= 1 - 0.07
&& \text{(substitute the prevalence)} \\
&= 0.93
&& \text{(subtract)}
\ea
$$

:::
